question: What will U.S. wheat net export sales be in the USDA Weekly Export Sales report released October 29, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Recent 2026/27 weekly net sales: 194.2k (Sep 3), 325.9k (Sep 10), 267.6k (Sep 17), ~284-290k (Sep 24), 451.6k (Oct 1), 319.9k (Oct 8); mean ~307k, 4-wk avg ~336k. Commitments are 10.43 MMT vs 15.46 MMT a year ago, so demand is weak, though the Black Sea export shortfall gives some upside and lumpy tenders can spike a week. Median ~320k with a wide right-skewed spread; small tails for negative (rare outside MY rollover) and >900k. No Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market found.
calls.dossier:
- Resolves off the first net sales number on the Wheat line of the FAS Weekly Highlights for 2026/27, released Oct 29, 2026 and covering the week ending ~Oct 22. It does not resolve off exports, a single class, or the accumulated total.
- Event window: reporting week ~Oct 16 -> Oct 22, 2026. As of Oct 19, about 40-50% of that window has elapsed. The Oct 22 release (week ending Oct 15) is not yet out.
- Weekly 2026/27 net sales (FAS via Brownfield, PriceGroup, IndexBox): week ending Sep 3: 194.2k (MY low; Philippines 88.4k, Ecuador 30k); Sep 10: 325.9k; Sep 17: 267.6k (-18% w/w, 13% below 4-wk avg); Sep 24: ~284-290k; Oct 1: 451.6k (15-week high); Oct 8: 319.9k.
- PriceGroup 10/16/2026: total commitments 10,429.2k MT vs 15,458.0k last year; undelivered 3,284k. Dec Chicago and KC trend described as down.
- Russian and Ukrainian export pace reported >50% below last year (PriceGroup 10/16); BCR says Black Sea Sept exports were ~80% below usual. Argentina's wheat export program is at a record pace into Indonesia and Brazil (BCR, 10/17).
- Background says Chicago wheat is ~670c, -7.6% m/m on ceasefire hopes and +35% y/y. Analysts expected 300-600k for the Oct 8 week.
- Spread: weekly wheat net sales in fall weeks typically have an SD of ~110-150k MT. In-season negative weeks are rare (mostly at the late-May MY rollover).
- Status quo: continuation of a ~270-340k weekly pace.
- Searched but not found: the week-ending-Oct-15 figure (releases Oct 22); a 10-year table of late-October weekly figures.
- Markets: no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market found.
calls.reference_class: US all-wheat weekly net sales in the Sep-Oct weeks of the 2026/27 marketing year, plus late-October weeks of prior marketing years

calls.reasoning: Weekly 2026/27 net sales: 194k, 326k, 268k, 290k, 452k, 320k (mean ~307k; latest 4-week average ~332k). The pace needed to hit USDA's 750 mbu forecast is ~310k/week. Demand is weak (commitments -32% y/y, HRW lagging, Argentine competition in Asia), against upside from the Black Sea export shortfall and lower prices. Median ~315k, right-skewed for tender spikes; ~1% tails for a negative week and for >900k. No human market found by the runs; no web access on this run.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed closely (medians 318-325k, 10-90 widths 330-340k). The 4-week-average discrepancy (270k vs 330k) was settled arithmetically: the two figures cover different windows and both are correct. The Sep 24 figure (~284-290k vs 289.5k) is immaterial. The median placement is pure judgment; I lean slightly lower (315k) because the structural weak-demand signals (commitments -32% y/y, export forecast cut, Argentine competition) outweigh the upside from the Black Sea shortfall. I carried forward the dispersion of ~335k, which is consistent with the realized weekly spread. Tail masses of 1% each are kept, since negatives are rare outside the MY rollover and >900k is implausible given weak demand. No web access on this run.

disagreements.verdict: Both correct, different windows: Sep 3-24 = 269.5k; Sep 17-Oct 8 = 332k
